submitted.rationale: Pb0.52Sb0.48 is close to the Pb2Sb2O7 pyrochlore composition (Naples-yellow type, band gap about 2.5 eV, so it absorbs 2.7 eV light). It gave the highest EQE of the three measurements (0.0084%). The compositions on either side of it measured lower.

rejected.reason: Pb-rich end (Pb 0.76): EQE about -0.001%, no photoresponse
Sb-rich of the pyrochlore (Pb 0.44): EQE 0.0001%, much lower than index 8
